title: Foundation for Payables Agent V2.0
summary: Payables Agent application refactored to support version 2.0 architecture that removes dependency on draft pages and E-Document framework, with backward compatibility preserved for existing v1 users.
key_points: Complete rewrite of Payables Agent app structure with new organizing principles documented in architecture.md
KPI tracking shifted from E-Documents to finalized Purchase Invoices to support both v1 and v2
V1 compatibility maintained so end-users experience no changes; v2 activation deferred pending validation
Added new codeunits for work item management, setup storage, subscribers, and telemetry
Multiple acknowledged v2 gaps documented including email sourcing, credit memos, feedback UI, and billing model impacts
quote: V1 compatibility is in place, so end-users won't feel this change, and we can activate when ready.
